significance: A much-visited Ganesha temple at Titwala on an ancient site, renovated under Peshwa Madhavrao I and rebuilt in 1965-66, with further work finished in 2009. Devotees come specifically to seek marriages and to settle marital difficulties.
story: Sage Kanva is said to have told Shakuntala, estranged from King Dushyanta, to raise a shrine here to Ganesha as Siddhi Vinayaka.
